title: Blue Cheese Fingerling Ranch Tray
seoTitle: Blue Cheese Fingerling Ranch Tray | Firehall BBQ
shortDescription: Loaded ranch potato salad—grilled spuds, bacon, cold tray that holds
subtitle: Grilled fingerlings, blue cheese ranch, chive, and radish tray for ten
description: Fingerling potatoes parboil, char on the grill, and fold into blue cheese ranch with crispy pancetta, chives, and sliced radish. A loaded side tray for ten.

steps.title: Parboil fingerlings
steps.instruction: Boil fingerling potatoes in salted water until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and cool slightly.

steps.title: Crisp pancetta
steps.instruction: Cook pancetta until crisp on a sheet pan in oven at 400°F or on flat-top. Crumble.

steps.title: Char on grill
steps.instruction: Toss parboiled potatoes with oil and salt. Grill in basket at 400°F until charred, 10–12 minutes.

steps.title: Build ranch dressing
steps.instruction: Whisk ranch, sour cream, vinegar, paprika, and salt until smooth.

steps.title: Fold salad
steps.instruction: Fold warm or cooled potatoes with dressing, bacon, cheddar, pickles, and green onions.

steps.title: Hold for service
steps.instruction: Hold refrigerated up to 24 hours or at 140°F in a hotel pan up to 60 minutes.

steps.title: Tray for ten
steps.instruction: Spread in a hotel pan, top with extra bacon and green onion at the line.

steps.title: Call guidance
steps.instruction: Potato salad holds fine refrigerated—pull from cooler when main protein is 10 minutes out.

proTips: Parboil until just tender—raw centers won't char in time.
Pickle chips add acid that cuts rich ranch and bacon.
Top with fresh green onion at service for color.
tonightSpread: Loaded ranch potato salad crew tray.
Perfect alongside any grill or griddle main.
leftovers: Reheat in skillet for crispy potato hash.
Stuff into breakfast burritos with eggs.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Blue cheese ranch and fingerlings beat another BBQ potato salad clone. Grilled spuds add char; pancetta adds salt; tray holds refrigerated or at 140°F for service.
mealPrepNotes: Parboil fingerlings ahead. Char on grill 400°F. Fold dressing cold—hold tray refrigerated up to 24 hours or at 140°F 60 minutes max.
